title: silene longicilia subsp. cintrana
intro: Silene longicilia subsp. cintrana, commonly known as Cintrana silene or mountain catchfly, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the family Caryophyllaceae. This plant has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including coughs and respiratory issues, due to its expectorant and anti-inflammatory properties. Its therapeutic actions include bronchodilation and mucolytic effects, which can help relieve congestion and promote the clearance of mucus from the airways. The bioactive constituents of Silene longicilia subsp. cintrana include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
